lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Sync Status Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in ensures pets and progress are saved across logins.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets being missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to keep your pet data and progress saved safely across sessions.

guard.reason: Adds a valid informational hint to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 27.1% and 8 support emails confirm user sync confusion; copy/hint change is low cost.

candidates.title: Path Selection Compact List Layout
candidates.change: Switches the path selection screen layout to a compact style for faster decision making.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen has a mean duration of 514s despite high conversion, indicating decision paralysis.

guard.reason: Updates the layout of the path selection screen while preserving onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Choose path already converts well (87.2%), though time is high; redesign showed positive signal in single test.

candidates.title: Sign In Split Benefits Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout showcasing account backup benefits alongside options.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% and multiple users experience account persistence confusion.

sign_in.headline: Keep Your Companion Safe
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync settings seamlessly.

guard.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen layout within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 27.1%, layout redesign addresses benefit clarity but requires significant UI work.

candidates.title: Adoption Summary Prep Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a simple summary screen right before finalizing adoption to review chosen options.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and high dropoff time.

new_adoption_summary.headline: Review Companion Setup
new_adoption_summary.body: Confirm your pet choices before generating your desktop mascot.

guard.reason: Inserts a new summary screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest dropoff (39.1%), but new screens historically showed no clear positive effect (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Initialization Status Indicator
candidates.change: Displays active status text and progress indicators on the waiting screen while rendering the pet.
candidates.why: The home/waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, causing users to wonder if the app stalled.

waiting.hint: Preparing desktop mascot graphics and initial animations...

guard.reason: Adds status indicators to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home step duration is very high (201s median); status indicators reduce perceived stall risk at low cost.

candidates.title: Mascot Desktop Shortcuts Flow
candidates.change: Appends a quick onboarding sub-flow detailing basic desktop hotkeys and interactions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets raised confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

new_mascot_shortcut_flow.headline: Quick Companion Commands
new_mascot_shortcut_flow.body: Learn how to summon, move, or hide your desktop pet with simple shortcuts.

guard.reason: Appends a new hotkey sub-flow following home_intro as permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 35.2%, but adding sub-flows in finish historically produced negative lift (-2.3%).

candidates.title: Home Welcome Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a focused stage layout highlighting the final launcher action.
candidates.why: The finish step has 64.8% conversion with an extended mean time of 5815s.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your new pet is ready to join your workspace.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro layout within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high dropoff (35.2%), but full stage redesigns measured negative lift (-1.0%) previously.

candidates.title: Starter Companion Perk Badge
candidates.change: Adds an extra badge highlighting included starter pet perks on the initial selection screen.
candidates.why: Reduces path selection hesitation (mean 514s) by emphasizing immediate user value.

guard.reason: 'choose_path.replace.path_options[0]': a badge cannot do the path_options job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Pet Photo Clarity Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Updates photo upload instructions to explicitly clarify lighting and single-subject criteria.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos focused on a single pet for accurate avatar generation.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry images or multiple pets in frame for best results.

guard.reason: Updates photo upload guidance copy clearly.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 39.1% with support tickets on photo failure; simple copy change is cheap and low risk.

candidates.title: Sign In Progress Loading Alert
candidates.change: Adds dynamic loading feedback and sign-in status updates on the login screen.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalls or screens failing to appear.

guard.reason: Adds loading status feedback to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop is 27.1% with stall reports; loading feedback directly addresses stalling concern.
